citeAs: Yonatan Bisk, Rowan Zellers, Ronan Le Bras, Jianfeng Gao, Yejin Choi (2020). PIQA: Reasoning about Physical Commonsense in Natural Language. AAAI.
creator: Yonatan Bisk, Rowan Zellers, Ronan Le Bras, Jianfeng Gao, Yejin Choi
description: A benchmark dataset for physical commonsense reasoning, consisting of multiple-choice questions about everyday physical situations and how-to instructions.
name: PIQA
publisher: Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence, Microsoft Research AI, Carnegie Mellon University, University of Washington
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: During validation, examples with low agreement were removed from the data. Data was collected in batches of several thousand triples and validated by other annotators for correctness. Users with low agreement were de-qualed.
rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Amazon Mechanical Turk (inferred from turkerview.com and HIT terminology)
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotators were prompted with links to instructables.com and asked to construct two component tasks. They articulated a physical goal, a valid solution, and a trick (an invalid solution with a subtle misunderstanding). A diff button highlighted where solutions differed.
rai:dataBiases: The authors noted reporting bias where people are drawn to prototypical solutions and look for tools in the kitchen or garage. To address this and flatten the distribution of referenced objects, they prompted annotations with links to instructables.
rai:dataCollection: Data was collected by prompting crowdsourced annotators with how-to instructions from instructables.com to inspire them to write goal-solution pairs and subtle incorrect solutions.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset was cleaned of basic artifacts using the AFLite algorithm to remove stylistic artifacts and trivial examples. Data was tokenized by Spacy.
rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking progress in physical commonsense understanding for natural language understanding models.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: AFLite algorithm (using BERT-Large), Spacy, GPT BPE tokenizer
